accepted.evidence: Dhakal p. 46 prints /bʰãtʰi/ “bellow.” Turner9424 gives Bihari south-of-Ganges bhā̃thī “bellows” and Nepali bhā̃ṭi “bellows”; the nasal vowel, aspirated initial and specialized sense all agree.
Dhakal p. 59 prints /cit.wa/ “leopard.” Turner4804 gives Nepali cituwā “leopard” alongside Maithili cittā and other regional forms; the Darai -tva is especially close to the Nepali reflex.
